interpretation: This case study shows that Relaytic-AML can host a rowless detector-score artifact as governed evidence: the adapter records schema and content hashes, creates evidence cells, redacts unsafe handoff fields, and blocks stronger detector or production claims. It is not a detector-performance result.

rows.observed: external-score adapter over a rowless fixture; schema hash 4b2b70a58b0c; content hash dac68c3801f5
rows.reader_takeaway: The score artifact is described by schema and hash posture, not by raw rows.
Relaytic records the governance metric as auditable evidence, not as detector novelty.

rows.observed: 11 exported fields; 16 blocked fields; no raw rows exported
rows.reader_takeaway: A downstream agent can inspect state without receiving rows, identifiers, paths, or secrets.

rows.observed: hosted detector-output governance only; 5 stronger claims blocked
rows.reader_takeaway: The public use is hosted detector-output governance only.

title: Hosted external-score case study
